name: gong_list_calls
description: List recorded calls from your workspace with optional date filtering. Returns call IDs, dates, participants, duration, and engagement metrics. Supports pagination for large result sets.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

name: gong_get_call
description: Get full details for a specific call by ID. Returns participants, duration, call metadata, engagement metrics, and key moments.

name: gong_get_transcript
description: Retrieve the full conversation transcript for a call with speaker names, timestamps, and dialogue. Use after gong_get_call to analyze specific conversations.

name: gong_list_users
description: List all users in your workspace. Returns user names, IDs, email addresses, roles, and activity status.

name: gong_search_calls
description: Search calls by keyword or phrase (e.g., 'pricing', 'objection', 'budget'). Returns matching calls ranked by relevance.

keyword.description: Keyword to search for in calls
